_comment: TEMPLATE (not a prototype): sports result (ESPN scoreboard + league site)
claim: The Buffalo Bills win their NFL game against the Baltimore Ravens scheduled 2026-11-01T18:00:00Z, final score including overtime.

elements.q: Do the exhibits show the Bills' game against the Ravens (event id 401873026) with status STATUS_FINAL and the Bills' final score higher than the Ravens' final score?

custom_definitions: FINAL_SCORE_V1 applies; the winner is the competitor with winner=true on a STATUS_FINAL event.
Postponed, suspended or cancelled games are not final: the element stays insufficient and the bet follows POSTPONED_V1/ABANDONED_EVENT_V1 caps, never NO.
The event is pinned by the ESPN event id and the scheduled kickoff; a rescheduled game keeps its id.
Burden of proof is on YES: an unproven or ambiguous element resolves NO.
Early resolution: YES may be declared at the first qualifying event; NO only at/after the deadline.
Fallback: a blocked, rate-limited or unreachable source is COULDNT_CHECK (never NO); the recovery ladder and the listed fallback source apply, then VOID.
